name: get_token_src
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
lane=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
plan=dict(url='https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.17962',routes=['362080'],destination='sources/token-graph-2402.17962.pdf',source_identity='Fabila-Monroy et al, On the Treewidth of Token and Johnson Graphs, arXiv 2402.17962',purpose='Read source definitions, theorems and the conjecture for target 362080 before any proof claim')
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'plans/get-token.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)
print('writer',w.returncode,w.stderr)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'source_get_guard.py'),'plans/get-token.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=str(lane))
print('guard exit',r.returncode); print(r.stdout[-1500:]); print(r.stderr[-1500:])
sys.exit(r.returncode)
